method: ARRIVAL (explicit | implicit) x ARM (bring a repo in | team pin). Six positives cover the backbone audit and the --team modes; four negatives are the doors it must not absorb — a refactor, installing the suite on one machine (install.sh --deps/--doctor), creating a documentation area, and a repo already sealed READY.

cases.prompt: Run init on this repo: it has no CONTEXT.md or ARCHITECTURE.md yet.
Lancia init --team required su acme-api, pinnando l'ultima release di Polaris.

I want every teammate on this repo to get the same Polaris version automatically when they open a session.

Make Polaris optional for this repo's team: just nudge people who don't have it installed.
Refactor the folder layout of this repo and move the CI config under ci/.
Install the Polaris suite and its MCP servers on my machine, and tell me what deps are missing.
Create a new documentation area for the billing module with its dossier.
